## Source growth program

### New candidates discovered today

Today's Japanese-platform research considered five previously untracked candidate families for the current source lane: 野いちご, ノベマ！, ノベモア, ノベルアップ＋, and pixiv novels. This satisfies the daily minimum of five newly discovered source or collection candidates.

### Full audits and admission decisions

**野いちご — PASS for link-only discovery.** The current official service exposes search, ranking, genre, review, and reading discovery surfaces. Its current terms state that the service is provided for personal use and access/use from Japan, while preserving platform/provider rights and the origin's own interfaces and rules. WebNR therefore admits only the official destination URL and WebNR-authored metadata; readers remain responsible for origin-region availability and current terms. Richer automation remains outside the admitted capability.

**ノベマ！ — PASS for link-only discovery.** The current official service exposes genre/ranking discovery. Current terms reserve site/provider/third-party rights and constrain unpermitted reuse. WebNR stores only a first-party discovery URL and its own description, with no origin content or platform data reuse. Richer integration remains deferred pending an explicitly permitted machine interface plus reproducible robots, cadence, paging, timeout, provenance, update/deletion, and rights fixtures.

**ノベモア — DEFER for automation; link-only candidate remains under review.** Its current terms, updated in July 2026, explicitly prohibit use of automated tools or scraping and reserve user-posted content rights to the authors while prohibiting unapproved reproduction/reuse. That makes any automated catalog or work ingestion inappropriate under the present WebNR source contract. No runtime adapter is admitted today.

**ノベルアップ＋ — DEFER.** Current public evidence confirms an active publisher-operated web-fiction service and public reader access, but today's evidence is not sufficient to establish a richer machine-interface, robots, cadence, pagination, provenance, update/deletion, and rights contract. It remains in the research queue rather than being admitted by inference.

**pixiv novels — DEFER.** pixiv remains a relevant Japanese creator/novel discovery ecosystem, but service-wide terms and account/content boundaries require a dedicated current audit before any WebNR admission. No automated access or content reuse is inferred from public discoverability.

The daily target of one passing integration is satisfied by pull request #102, which admits two link-only first-party destinations after review.
